title: Khari Ennui - Wynd
htmlContent:
Chicago Alternative-Hip Hop Artist Khari Ennui shares a new track called "Wynd," a special piece of audio that serves it purpose. It’s a record that goes beyond just good sounds to hear, but a masterpiece that connects to the listener on a body and soul level. He delivers in every way on what is a master class performance to stand out in every way on this must hear song.
